about: Queue of data sources to investigate for the cwplans scoping project (Canary Wharf, Isle of Dogs, Limehouse, Rotherhithe / SE16). Readable view: SOURCES-TO-INVESTIGATE.md. Licence classes follow the project rule (CLAUDE.md, cwplans exception): open = may be committed; share-alike = counts only, a committed extract needs the owner's agreement; restricted = do not fetch for the repo; unknown = check first.
origin: Gemini answer pasted by the owner on 2026-10-06 (street-level imagery, aerial imagery, LiDAR, London Datastore), checked against what the project already holds; plus candidates found while checking.
